data.title: Add WorkStarted and WorkCompleted event types
data.body:
## Summary

Add two new event types to track change-ids when work starts and completes on a bug.

## Implementation

In `src/event.rs`, add to `EventData`:

```rust
/// Records when work begins on a bug
WorkStarted {
    change_id: String,  // jj change-id where work will happen
},

/// Records when work completes
WorkCompleted {
    change_id: String,  // jj change-id that implements the fix
},
```

Update `derive_bug()` to handle these events.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] WorkStarted variant added to EventData
- [ ] WorkCompleted variant added to EventData
- [ ] derive_bug() handles both events (stores change_ids in Bug)
- [ ] Existing tests pass
- [ ] New unit tests for event parsing
